name: Custom Frustum Ray Generation via Vertex Z-Index
aliases: Ray Direction Assignment via Frustum Corners
definition: A technique to generate per-pixel ray directions for raymarching by encoding the index of pre-computed frustum corner vectors into the Z-coordinate of a full-screen quad's vertices, allowing the vertex shader to look up the correct ray direction from a uniform array.
summary: Custom Frustum Ray Generation via Vertex Z-Index encodes frustum corner indices in vertex Z-coordinates to perform discrete ray direction lookups in the vertex shader, avoiding per-fragment matrix multiplications.
